name: AUDIT-Y1-every-timer-writes
old: if (!t || t.n !== n) return;   // a later press's own wait writes it
new: if (!t) return;   // a later press's own wait writes it
note: each press's wait writes, not the last

name: AUDIT-Y1-over-the-write-under-way
old: if (t.busy) { t.again = true; return; }   // written after the answer under way
note: a second write sent over the one still answered

name: AUDIT-Y1-presses-during-lost
old: if (t.n !== n) { if (t.again) { const m = t.n; later(() => { writeTurn(id, m); }, 0); } return; }   // pressed meanwhile
note: the presses made while a write was answered never written

name: AUDIT-Y1-written-from-the-press
old: const want = decorPieceOf({ ...(standing() ?? t.held), rot: t.rot });
note: a light put out meanwhile written back on

name: AUDIT-Y1-refusal-undoes-all
old: if (now) pool.put(decorPieceOf({ ...now, rot: t.held.rot }) ?? t.held);   // refused: turned back as it was
new: if (now) pool.put(t.held);   // refused: turned back as it was
note: a refused turn undoes the light put out after it

name: AUDIT-Y1-refusal-stands
old: if (now) pool.put(decorPieceOf({ ...now, rot: t.held.rot }) ?? t.held);   // refused: turned back as it was
note: a refused turn shown as if written

name: AUDIT-Y2-removed-written
note: a removed piece's turn written - the service's refusal said for nothing

name: AUDIT-Y2-answer-stands-it-again
old: if (now) pool.put(decorPieceOf({ ...now, rot: stood.rot }) ?? now);   // the service's own turn
note: an answer after the removal stands the piece again
